proven_root_causes.cause: get_operator_health_status executed all five health groups and DomainGovernancePort.list_governance_review_queue_items' three owner reads (approval_records, list_deployment_plans, list_evolution_decisions) strictly serially, and get_human_inbox executed its persona/capital owner reads (list_personas, list_bindings, list_capital_pools) in a second serial waterfall after health completed. On both failed reload runs (20:00:10Z and 20:39:05Z), no single owner HTTP call exceeded 1.832s, but the 6-step serial sum in get_operator_health_status reached 3.062s and 3.113s, crossing the 3.0s PANTHEON_BFF_COCKPIT_READ_TIMEOUT_SECONDS budget before Section 1 (runtime_health) could complete and leaving completed_sections empty (operator_home: {}, runtime_health: {}).
proven_root_causes.repair: Execute the independent health group reads and governance/cockpit owner read warmers concurrently within request_read_scope on a bounded worker pool while bounding group wait to the remaining management_read_deadline with headroom so runtime_health and operator_home complete in max(owner_latency) rather than sum(owner_latency).

proven_root_causes.cause: cached_owner_call checked and populated request_read_cache without synchronization, so concurrent threads sharing a request_read_scope via copy_context().run could race or duplicate identical owner reads.
proven_root_causes.repair: Add per-key RLock synchronization on _RequestReadCache in cached_owner_call and lock-protected eviction in evict_request_read_keys so distinct owner reads run in parallel while identical in-flight owner keys within the same request are deduplicated.

proven_root_causes.cause: run_management_read did not propagate its outer deadline to inner contributor reads (_StoreTimeoutProxy, _bounded_persona_readiness_rows) or subsequent cockpit sections, allowing timed-out worker threads to continue spawning fresh 3.0s contributor reads across the reload window.
proven_root_causes.repair: Propagate management_read_deadline via ContextVar in run_management_read and cap _StoreTimeoutProxy, _bounded_persona_readiness_rows, and post-deadline cockpit sections to remaining_management_read_budget.

proven_root_causes.cause: _bounded_get_human_inbox mutated self._resolve_store on the shared ManagementService instance across concurrent cockpit and human-inbox requests and declared synchronous GET handlers as async def without await.
proven_root_causes.repair: Bind _StoreTimeoutProxy per-request via _MANAGEMENT_STORE_OVERRIDE ContextVar instead of mutating self._resolve_store on ManagementService, and declare synchronous GET route handlers as def so FastAPI runs them on its threadpool.
